market_summary: FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and US100 are heavily consolidating inside their daily Value Areas around VWAP during late London session, lacking breakout momentum and yellow RVOL volume spikes. BTCUSD displays decisive directional momentum, breaking down below its Value Area Low and session lows with expanding volatility and aligned bearish CVD.

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (1.10779 to 1.10998) and below POC 1.10943. CVD is NEUTRAL (+2,361) with negative slope (-4,018), diverging from recent morning up-move. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price rejected Session High 1.11027 and is currently pressing down through EMA50 (1.10896) and testing VWAP (1.10863). ATR envelope is mid-channel and contracting. RVOL is modest (1.072) with no yellow spike confirmation. GEX is null. Given lack of trend conviction inside Value Area, HOLD is prudent.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral consolidating around VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (1.32605 to 1.32797) and below POC 1.32738. CVD is BEARISH (-4,238) with negative slope (-2,309). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is flat against VWAP (1.32672) and EMA50 (1.32700), tightly compressed mid-ATR channel. Volume is muted with RVOL at 1.189 without expansion spikes. GEX is null. The chop between support at 1.32618/1.32661 and resistance at Session High 1.32809 warrants a HOLD.

Price is inside Value Area (28086.57 to 28185.57) but holding above POC (28121.92). CVD is BEARISH (-2.97) but essentially flat/neutral tick volume. Session is LONDON_SESSION ahead of NY open. Price is holding above VWAP (28132.62) and EMA20 (28143.51), testing below descending EMA50 (28161.74). Volume lacks RVOL spikes (US100 caveat noted). Trapped between S/R support at 28100 and EMA50 resistance, with no clean directional edge inside the range. GEX is null. HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish reclaiming VWAP and holding above POC

signals.rationale: Price is below VAL (73338.96) and well below POC (73536.49), confirming bearish value area distribution. CVD is BEARISH (-0.06) with negative slope. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Trend is strongly bearish below downward-sloping VWAP (73571.40) and EMA50 (73538.46). The signal candle flushed lower and breached the -2 ATR lower band (72990.54) with expanding ATR. RVOL is elevated at 1.521 breaking Session Low 72812.20, with live price at 72805.30 continuing lower. Strong bearish momentum continuation setup.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish breaking below VAL and session lows
